name: EvoBench
description: EvoBench is a dynamic benchmark for evaluating detection methods of LLM-generated text, focusing on generalization across continuously evolving LLMs including updates and model developments.
reputation: A recent ACL Findings benchmark that is gaining attention in LLM-generated text detection research, especially for testing robustness to model evolution.
notes: Focuses on real-world evolving LLM-generated text detection; introduces EMG metric; evaluates 14 detection methods.
